answer: Joining costs a bond of 300 POA frozen in a glacier vault that thaws 25 POA a month, so a farm pays 300 for every fake and waits a year to get it back. A raven patrol of four bonded auditors, drawn at random each week, checks agents against their work records. Each agent tends a grove of job receipts that grows week by week, and a fake with copied or empty work cannot grow one. A caught fake loses the unthawed bond, half paid to the ravens who found it, and its key is barred for three years.
